answer_details.question: How long do I have to write my master's thesis?
answer_details.answer: You have six months to complete your master’s thesis [1][5]. If the work can be finished in less than five months, the supervisor must justify the shorter period in writing to the Examination Committee [1]. In individual cases, you may request an extension of up to six weeks, provided you submit a justified request at least one week before the deadline and obtain the supervisor’s approval [5].

answer_details.question: Can my master's thesis deadline be extended?
answer_details.answer: Yes, the deadline can be extended under certain conditions. The Examination Committee may grant an extension of up to four weeks if you submit a request at least one week before the deadline and your supervisor approves it [1][2]. In programmes with special provisions, the Committee may extend the time by up to six weeks in justified individual cases, also requiring a request one week in advance and supervisor approval [3]. If you fall ill, the deadline may be extended to a maximum of twice the original period, provided you submit a medical certificate without delay [1]. For parental leave, the allowed period can be doubled after a written application with evidence at least four weeks before the start date [4].

answer_details.question: Do I need German health insurance to enrol?
answer_details.answer: Yes. Every student enrolled at a German university must be a member of a statutory (German) health insurance, and the insurer must send an electronic notification of your insurance status to the university; without this the enrollment cannot be finalized[4]. Even if you have private coverage, you still need to involve a statutory insurer so that the required electronic notification is sent[4]. The notification is mandatory regardless of whether you are physically present in Germany[4]. If you are over 30 and not obliged to take student insurance, a soft copy of your passport may be sufficient, but the statutory insurer still has to confirm your status[4].

answer_details.question: Kann ich ein Urlaubssemester beantragen?
answer_details.answer: Ja, ein Urlaubssemester kann beantragt werden, wenn ein wichtiger Grund (z. B. Krankheit, Schwangerschaft, freiwilliger Wehrdienst) nachgewiesen wird [1][2]. Der Antrag muss mit dem Beurlaubungsformular und den erforderlichen Nachweisen (Gebühren‑/Beitragsnachweis, Nachweis des wichtigen Grundes) eingereicht werden [2][3]. Er muss **vor Beginn des Urlaubssemesters** gestellt werden; eine nachträgliche Beurlaubung für ein bereits abgelaufenes Semester ist nicht zulässig [2][3]. Eine Beurlaubung im ersten Fachsemester ist grundsätzlich ausgeschlossen, außer bei Master‑Studierenden oder bei einer Erkrankung im laufenden Semester [2]. Die Hochschulverwaltung kann in Ausnahmefällen abweichende Entscheidungen treffen, wenn die Voraussetzungen erst später eintreten [2].
